title: Notched tiles of the Masjid-e Ali, Isfahan
subtitle: Masjid-e Ali, Isfahan

given.O: The centre of a small square, at a half-turn point.
given.A: The right corner of that square.

construction.note: The finished design was read from Brian Wichmann’s IRA1330 drawing and its corners snapped to exact values. OA is the half-diagonal of a small square. Two compass transfers of the unit-square diagonal give the rectangular repeat. The drawing gives no steps; we devised the construction.
construction.changes: The plain tile boundaries are retained. The palette is illustrative. No building photograph was checked. The compass steps, their order and the named points are ours.

credits.source: Tiling Search, data189/IRA1330: Masjid-e Ali, Isfahan
credits.creator: Brian Wichmann
credits.note: Read from his finished drawing, not construction instructions. His page cites David Wade’s IRA 1330 photograph of the Masjid-e Ali, Isfahan, Iran (1552 AD, 959 AH).

steps.text: Draw a horizontal straight line through O and A. Draw a circle with centre O through A.

Draw a vertical line through O. The two lines cross the circle at A, B, C and D. Draw a vertical line through each of A and B. Draw a horizontal line through each of C and D. They cross at K1, K2, K3 and K4. Draw a straight line through O and K1.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: Draw a vertical line through O. The two lines cross the circle at A, B, C and D. Draw a vertical line through A. Draw a horizontal line through C. They cross at K1. Draw a straight line through O and K1.

steps.text: Draw a straight line through A and C. Turn it round O by 90°, three times. Draw the line through O at 90° to the line from O to K1.
The line from O to K1 crosses the circle at F. Draw a vertical line through F. It crosses the horizontal line through O at M.
Draw a circle with centre O through K1. Draw a circle with centre A, with the same opening. It crosses the horizontal line through O at W, right of A.

Draw a circle with centre W, with the same opening. It crosses the horizontal line through O at Z, right of W. Draw a circle with centre O through Z. It crosses the vertical line through O at V, above O.
Draw a vertical line through W. Draw a horizontal line through V. Turn both lines round O by 180°. They cross at N1, N2, N3 and N4.
Draw a circle with centre A and opening OM. It crosses the horizontal line through O at R, right of A. Draw a vertical line through R. Turn it round O by 180°.
Draw a circle with centre V and opening OM. It crosses the vertical line through O at S, below V. Draw a horizontal line through S. Turn it round O by 180°.
Draw a circle with centre Z and opening OA. It crosses the horizontal line through O at J, right of Z. Draw a line through each of Z and J at 90° to the line from O to K1.
Turn both lines through Z and J round O by 90°, three times.
Join N1, N2, N3 and N4 to mark the tile that repeats.

ink.text: Ink the lines picked out in orange.

pattern.text: Put copies of the rectangular tile side by side.
